title: Brent-WTI spread z-score leads FRO
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Brent-WTI spread 20d z-score > 2 leads tanker equities higher by 2 days (+) as ton-mile demand reprices; trade long FRO 5d [finance.spread.brent_wti -> finance.FRO.log_return]
message: Weak: r=0.10 (lag 5d), 22 trades hit 59% but excess -0.3%/trade vs baseline, war-test n=10 avg +0.18%; actionability 1.44 - story not a rule

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.spread.brent_wti rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long FRO next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 5 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Brent-WTI spread 20d z-score > 1 leads FRO log returns lower over 3 days (-) as spread spikes fade and tanker rally reverses; trade short FRO 3d [finance.spread.brent_wti -> finance.FRO.log_return] (parent: R2-0019)
